reasoning: batch 1: Independent inspection of the unchanged 728x657 panel confirms a single linear Pressure [kPa] axis and linear CO2 Loading [mmol/g] axis, with plot frame approximately x=173..694 px and y=60..512 px. Tick calibration from the printed anchors gives x≈0.2301 kPa/px (residual ≈0.60 px) and y≈−0.006644 mmol/g/px (residual ≈0.64 px), consistent with the supplied calibration. The legend identifies six eligible filled CO2 series: red circles 303K, orange squares 313K, green up-triangles 323K, blue pentagons 333K, magenta diamonds 353K, and black stars 373K. The low-pressure region contains thick continuous colored bands that must be represented by retained line_sample rows, but it does not contain the many separable marker centres proposed by template filling. Native tiles and enlarged crops show no glyphs at the deleted template/fit positions. The visible marker-bearing regions from about x=3 to 114 kPa were checked across the full panel; no source-supported omitted marker was found. The post-edit set retains continuous trace samples and partial markers where native ink supports them, so the result requires review rather than acceptance.
